text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening calls as of 0830 CDT.

CANOLA - C$2.00 to C$3.00 a tonne lower on lower CBOT soycomplex calls, overbought sentiments from Friday's trade with losses limited by hot, dry Prairie weekend weather and today's forecast for the same. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -5.85 Friday from -3.24 Thursday. Canada's dollar opened lower at C$1.3796, rose to 85.92 yen and rose to 1.3607 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on overbought sentiments. September seen down C$4 after Friday's C$9.30 higher close.
WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne lower on CBOT corn calls.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 down on CBOT corn and wheat calls.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 a tonne lower on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
